name: COS remains signed out for reconciliation QA
description: Verifies the production sign-in gate without initializing an Owner identity or creating operational records. Owner selector positive and invalid-selection cases run separately in tests/ownerJobSelection.test.mjs with synthetic records; this signed-out run does not certify authenticated controls. Normal Owner session and actor resolution are additionally covered by isolated Auth-directory/PostgREST transports: valid existing identity, missing/inactive/revoked accounts and no implicit Auth/profile/role/audit writes. Explicit provisioning is not exercised by hosted QA. Owner Review loading, native snapshot success, genuine empty queues, persistent failures/retries and independent mobile reads are covered by separate local synthetic transport/browser tests; hosted signed-out QA does not certify a real Owner review or evidence file delivery. History native snapshot evidence availability, real-zero versus unknown counts, and persistent load errors/retries are separately covered by isolated transport and synthetic browser tests; no all-job evidence aggregation or private preview delivery is claimed. Owner Tech Check overview completion/evidence/failed-check availability and persistent read-error/retry states are covered by separate synthetic browser tests; hosted signed-out QA does not certify complete operational evidence data. The shared presentation and workspace-menu behavior are separately verified with synthetic local Chromium fixtures; hosted signed-out QA does not certify an authenticated technician workflow.
covers: reconciliation QA performs no production writes
Owner Controls are unavailable before sign-in
GET /api/session read-only existing Owner validation (isolated transports)
shared native Owner actor resolution without implicit provisioning (isolated transports)
missing/inactive/revoked Owner fails closed without borrowing another actor (isolated transports)
GET /api/owner-review existing active Owner native snapshot read (isolated transports)
Owner Review desktop/mobile loading, error/retry, successful empty queue and stale-request handling (local synthetic Chromium tests)
mobile jobs and billing reads are independent of Owner Review failure (local synthetic Chromium tests)
missing private evidence delivery is labeled unavailable; no broken native evidence links (local synthetic Chromium tests)
GET /api/jobs marks native placeholder evidence arrays unavailable without additional source reads or writes (isolated transports)
History unknown counts do not display zero; successful empty queue, failed/malformed read, retry and stale navigation are separate states (local synthetic Chromium tests)
Owner Tech Check overview does not infer completion or zero failures from omitted/placeholder fields (synthetic Chromium tests)
Owner Tech Check overview preserves real lifecycle/attention flags and separates loading/error/retry/successful empty states (synthetic Chromium tests)
Shared navy/silver VISION presentation across desktop/mobile Owner, IT and Service shells (local synthetic Chromium)
Workspace menu selection, focus restoration, Escape and Tab boundaries (local synthetic Chromium)

steps: Remain signed out. Do not sign in, enter demo mode, provision identities or seed production records.

Request https://api-v2.appdeploy.ai/app/cos-operations-platform-preview-wpbf1y/api/reconciliation/storage-hash?path=jobs/test.jpg without credentials. Verify HTTP 401 and no digest, signed URL or source records.

Using the same https://api-v2.appdeploy.ai/app/cos-operations-platform-preview-wpbf1y base, send JSON POST requests with credentials omitted and empty JSON objects to /api/jobs/00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000/schedule, /api/jobs/00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000/assign, and /api/owner/jobs/00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000/advance-it.
Verify all three scheduling write endpoints return HTTP 401 and no operational records.

Using the same app API base, request GET /api/session and GET /api/tech/visits/00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000 without credentials. POST an empty JSON object without credentials to /api/tech/visits/00000000-0000-0000-000000000000/complete.

Verify the two reads and the completion endpoint all return HTTP 401. Also request GET /api/owner-tasks using the same app API base without credentials; verify HTTP 401 and no task data. Confirm the application stays at its sign-in gate; do not create accounts or complete a real visit.

Using that API base while signed out, POST empty JSON objects with credentials omitted to /api/field-map/00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000/gps and /api/tech/jobs/00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000/field-gps. Both must return HTTP 401 without changing a coordinate. Do not sign in, upload evidence or change a real job.
expected: All ten requests deny access before operational reads or writes. Authenticated account, assigned-details, completion, Today loading and GPS save logic are separately covered by local regression tests. No real authenticated workflow, physical GPS capture or hosted map success is claimed by this signed-out QA run.
